data.title: Nikki Beach Residences
data.about:
Discover the splendor of Nikki Beach Residences, a flagship development by Aldar Properties on the stunning Al Marjan Island. This illustrious project presents a diverse array of luxuriously furnished apartments, ranging from intimate 1-bedroom abodes to expansive 4-bedroom residences, and further to the pinnacle of elegance in 5-bedroom villas. 

Each home in Nikki Beach Residences Al Marjan Island features generously sized balconies that provide awe-inspiring views of the Arabian Gulf. This collaboration between Aldar Properties and the Nikki brand has resulted in an exceptional sanctuary of comfort and sophistication in the peaceful surroundings of Al Marjan Island. 

Leading the way in health and wellness, the Nikki Beach Residences is the first in Ras Al Khaimah to earn the prestigious global FitWel certification. The development nurtures a communal atmosphere with its deluxe clubhouse and versatile hospitality suite, ideal for fostering shared experiences among residents.

location_tile.title: Experience Luxury at Al Marjan Island
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Nestled in Ras Al Khaimah's emirate, Al Marjan Island stands as a breathtaking man-made archipelago in the Arabian Gulf. It's renowned as a luxurious retreat, boasting pristine beaches and top-tier resorts. The island's unique coral reef-like shape is comprised of four interconnected coral islands, lined by a central boulevard. Visitors are greeted with 5.4 kilometers of white sandy beaches, offering an array of activities from sunbathing to thrilling water sports in the crystal-clear Gulf waters.

Al Marjan Island is more than a beach haven; it's a hub of luxury. With a plethora of upscale hotels and resorts, it caters to every taste, balancing leisure and business needs with finesse. Architectural marvels meet private beachfronts, pools, spas, and exquisite dining experiences. The retail and dining landscape is just as impressive, featuring chic boutiques and waterfront restaurants that showcase global culinary delights, all set against the backdrop of this coral-shaped wonder.

  • 05 Minutes – InterContinental Mina Al Arab
  • 07 Minutes – Al Naeem Mall
  • 11 Minutes – RAK Mall
  • 12 Minutes – RAK Hospital
  • 25 Minutes – Ras Al Khaimah International Airport
  • 30 Minutes – Dhayah Fort
